projects.title: Connect Health
projects.summary: A field view for reading where Connect groups need attention and why, with filters and alternate ways to inspect the same fictional sample.
projects.context: The portfolio version is an isolated local demo with anonymized fictional data. It makes no Rock requests, has no production connection, and links to no real group records.
projects.disclosure: Fictional local data only. Interactive prototype; it is not connected to Rock and is not a live dashboard.

projects.title: Skill Heaven
projects.summary: A session-context toolkit that starts agent sessions clean and summons the skills needed for the current task without installing them permanently.
projects.context: The public documentation describes one /summon mechanic and four choosing surfaces: Zero, Heaven, Hell, and Ultra. Benchmark-derived trust routing is not built; the portfolio links to the current implementation and docs rather than claiming it is.
projects.disclosure: Public preview and source repository. Links open the actual project; the portfolio does not install or run an agent session.
projects.role: Core implementation / session-context flow, agent plugin, and launchers

live.label: Explore the live Skill Heaven site

projects.title: Gaia Research
projects.summary: An evidence-first lab for agent capability, with public research, Infinite Skill Craft, and Context Diet browser experiments.
projects.context: The live site and repository document the labs and research. Portfolio copy links to those materials and does not restate unverified benchmark results.
projects.disclosure: Public research site and source. The interactive labs run at the linked site; there is no external-site embed here.
projects.role: Core contribution / research site, browser labs, and benchmark-ingest tooling

projects.title: Rock MCP
projects.summary: An MCP server for Rock RMS with OAuth-backed caller context, read-only access, report tools, and tightly authorized writes.
projects.context: The public repository documents the OAuth, tool, and authorization flow. The interactive explanation on this portfolio is offline; no Rock server or credential is contacted.
projects.disclosure: Public source repository only. No live endpoint, credentials, or Rock data are connected to this portfolio.
projects.role: Creator and maintainer / MCP server, OAuth gateway, and tool surface

projects.title: macdash
projects.summary: A dependency-free terminal dashboard that reads native macOS tools for CPU, GPU, memory, swap, network, load, uptime, disk, battery, and thermal state.
projects.context: The live program reads the machine it runs on. This portfolio's small terminal replay uses deterministic sample values only and never reads the visitor's device.
projects.disclosure: Sample values in this page are fictional. The source link opens the utility; no live machine telemetry is shown here.

projects.title: Fuel ABEMIS
projects.summary: A pilot study combining national machinery inventory and laboratory performance data to model fuel consumption, then inspect model behavior with SHAP and LIME.
projects.context: The public README reports holdout results for its best Random Forest model: R² 0.91, MAE 1.09 L/h, and RMSE 1.61 L/h. Those are dataset-specific project results, not a general performance guarantee.
projects.disclosure: Collaborative pilot study. Reported metrics are scoped to the project's holdout data and source README; they are not a generalization claim.
projects.role: Collaborative study with BAFE Engineer Rosas

media.alt: SHAP global feature-importance bar chart from the Fuel ABEMIS pilot model, with power_kw as the largest plotted contribution.
media.caption: Static SHAP summary from the public project repository; a pilot-model explanation, not a live analysis.

projects.title: People, compiled
projects.summary: A self-contained fictional-data dashboard. Open the compiled page to try its chart-view cycler, which changes the selected view.
projects.context: Compiled static HTML, CSS and local font/texture dependencies. The chart-view cycler updates the selected mode and URL. Campus links only rewrite the URL; they do not filter the embedded fictional dataset. No remote data requests.
projects.disclosure: Fictional prototype data. This is not a live Rock connection, a production dashboard, or actual people records.
